name: Spirit Devourer
tactics: A spirit devourer uses trap spirit until it succeeds in trapping a foe, at which point it gains a +2 bonus to all of its defenses. It uses devour spirit to deal damage to the trapped creature and then uses the energy it devours to heal itself or use soul rupture. If at any point the trapped spirit escapes, the spirit devourer begins using trap spirit again.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: Radiant
weaknesses.details: (whenever the devourer takes radiant damage, its trapped enemy gets a saving throw to escape)

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Spirit Ward
traits.details: The spirit devourer gains a +2 bonus to all defenses while it has a creature trapped.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is trapped (save ends). The trapped creature is removed from play and can take no actions. If it succeeds on a saving throw, it escapes and appears in an unoccupied space adjacent to the spirit devourer. A trapped creature escapes automatically when the spirit devourer is destroyed. Only one creature can be trapped at a time

powers.name: Spirit Rupture
powers.requirements: usable only after the spirit devourer uses devour spirit and only on the same turn

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the target is immobilized until the end of the spirit devourer’s next turn.

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is not immobilized

effect.description: The spirit devourer deals 10 necrotic damage to a creature it has trapped (see trap spirit). The spirit devourer either regains 10 hit points or uses spirit rupture. A creature killed by this power can't be returned to life with a Raise Dead ritual.
